project_title: MIM TOD Automatic Reality Response V1
goal: Make MIM/TOD act on project-board reality automatically instead of waiting for Dave or Codex to notice stalled, drifting, or unmeasurable projects.

intervention_rules.trigger: Project has no explicit acceptance criteria.
intervention_rules.action: Write a MIM/TOD intervention event and set current driving task to define acceptance criteria.

intervention_rules.trigger: Project scope expands beyond the original acceptance path.
intervention_rules.action: Write a MIM/TOD intervention event and set next action to split expanded work into a follow-on project.

intervention_rules.trigger: Project progress is high but not accepted.

intervention_rules.action: Require blocker resolution, reclassification, escalation, or archive.

intervention_rules.trigger: Project remains waiting or blocked long enough to become stale or needs review.
intervention_rules.action: Require promote, block, archive, or assign a new bounded driving task.

spam_control: At most one automatic intervention per rule per project per UTC day.
acceptance_criteria: Projects API returns auto_intervention_count for the current page load.
Automatic interventions create StudioProjectEvent rows with event_type mim_auto_intervention.
Automatic interventions update next_action/current_driving_task instead of only reporting status.
Missing acceptance and scope expansion are acted on before ordinary improvement work.
